title: Manhunter #29 SIGNED Marc Andreyko DC 2007 Wonder Woman Verdict Hostile
conditionDescription: Signed by writer Marc Andreyko in black marker on the front cover, inscribed "to Robert!"; no COA. Cover bright with light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Manhunter #29 (May 2007), DC Comics - "Verdict: Hostile", Wonder Woman on trial. Signed on the front cover by writer Marc Andreyko and inscribed "to Robert!". No COA. Art by Javier Pina and Robin Riggs. Direct sales, $2.99 cover price.

Back cover: Jade Empire Special Edition (PC) ad.

Condition: bright with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
